archetypes.name: dyn-hook-boundary
archetypes.rationale: Subprocess hook bypass changes the boundary between Claude children and orchestrator polling guards.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the changed Claude subprocess launch path and hook exemption as one boundary. Check that the exemption is only set for spawned Claude children, only exact value 1 bypasses the hook, and normal orchestrator Read, Bash, Monitor, and TaskOutput denials remain covered by tests and docs. Look for environment leakage or ordering mistakes around fail-open behavior. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
